framework.name: Standard Implementation Framework
framework.description: A complete framework for standard implementation projects with 4 delivery stages

stage.name: Discovery & Planning
stage.description: Initial discovery phase for requirements gathering and project planning
stage.exitCriteria: Requirements document approved, project plan finalized

stage.name: Development
stage.exitCriteria: All features implemented and unit tested

project.name: Enterprise Implementation
project.description: Full-scale enterprise implementation project template with all standard phases

project.name: Quick Start Project
project.description: Lightweight project template for small implementations

deliverable.title: Discovery Documentation
deliverable.description: Complete discovery phase documentation including requirements, stakeholder analysis, and project charter

deliverable.title: MVP Release
deliverable.description: Minimum viable product delivery with core functionality

epic.title: User Authentication System
epic.description: Complete user authentication including login, registration, password reset, and session management

epic.title: Dashboard & Analytics
epic.description: Main dashboard with key metrics, charts, and reporting capabilities

task.title: Setup Development Environment
task.description: Configure local development environment with all necessary tools, dependencies, and access credentials

task.title: Requirements Workshop
task.description: Conduct stakeholder workshop to gather and document detailed requirements

task.title: Code Review
task.description: Review pull requests and ensure code quality standards are met

role.name: Project Manager
role.description: Responsible for overall project delivery, timeline management, budget control, and stakeholder communication

role.name: Lead Developer
role.description: Technical lead responsible for architecture decisions, code reviews, and mentoring team members

role.name: Business Analyst
role.description: Gathers and documents requirements, creates user stories, and manages stakeholder expectations

role.name: QA Engineer
role.description: Responsible for test planning, test execution, and quality assurance activities
